name: Feature Color Autocycle
description: Four feature cards beside one sticky tall panel that auto-advances through brand-tinted states, crossfading mockups, with a per-card progress bar that fills over each interval. Clicking a card jumps to it and restarts; hovering the grid pauses; it only cycles while in view.
interactions: auto-advance every 4500ms (verbatim): active card crossfades its panel layer (.5s), panel fill tweens between brand tints (.6s), card bg tints (.5s)
active card progress bar fills left->right over the interval (wpmn-fcac-fill var(--fcac-dur) linear), restarted on each switch
click a card -> jump + restart the timer; grid mouseenter pauses, mouseleave resumes
IntersectionObserver (threshold .25) only runs the cycle while the section is in view
below 768px the grid stacks to one column, the panel moves above the cards, progress bars hide
prefers-reduced-motion: no auto-advance, transitions off, progress bar shown full; clicking still switches
